intent: Supabase OAuth 2.1 server for agents: /auth/consent approve/deny page, config for asymmetric JWT + OAuth server + consent URL, verify end to end.
summary: Built and locally verified the OAuth 2.1 consent flow (PSI-074). CODE: src/app/auth/consent/page.tsx (client page: reads authorization_id, gates on session via supabase.auth.getUser, calls auth.oauth.getAuthorizationDetails, shows client name/logo + user email + scopes, Approve via approveAuthorization / Deny via denyAuthorization with skipBrowserRedirect then router.replace to the returned redirect_url; auto-redirects when already consented; handles missing/invalid authorization_id); src/app/auth/consent/consent-lib.ts (pure formatScopes + resolveConsentState + signInUrlForConsent, unit-tested); 6 unit tests. CONFIG: supabase/config.toml [auth.oauth_server] enabled=true, authorization_url_path=/auth/consent, allow_dynamic_registration=true. VERIFIED LOCALLY against the running stack (supabase start): OAuth server metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (issuer, authorize/token/userinfo/registration endpoints); JWKS is ES256 asymmetric; dynamic client registration returns a client_id; authorize with PKCE + admin@p3md.test session 302-redirects to http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/consent?authorization_id=...; getAuthorizationDetails returns {client{name}, user{email}, scope} exactly as the consent page consumes; PKCE enforced (missing code_challenge -> invalid_request). HOSTED items (human-gated, no Supabase credentials in scope): enable OAuth server + asymmetric JWT keys + consent URL on the hosted project Settings per docs/backend-architecture/local-workflow-and-deploy.md; Claude Desktop end-to-end connect on hosted. /auth/consent is public in proxy.ts PUBLIC_PREFIXES so the page itself handles the auth gate.

changes.note: OAuth 2.1 consent page (approve/deny, session gate, auto-redirect)
6 unit tests for scopes + state resolution
[auth.oauth_server] enabled, consent URL /auth/consent, dynamic registration on

decisions.decision: Use supabase.auth.getUser() (client) for the session gate, not server-only getSession
decisions.reason: Consent page is a client component under /auth (public prefix); getUser matches the notifications-page pattern.
Control the redirect in-app (and keep a fallback to /dashboard/overview if no URL) rather than letting Supabase auto-redirect.

decisions.decision: Enable OAuth server locally in config.toml
decisions.reason: Agent-doable config that mirrors the hosted requirement; lets the full authorize→consent→approve flow be exercised deterministically. Hosted settings remain human (no credentials).

verification.manual: Local Supabase stack: registered dynamic client, ran authorize with PKCE as admin@p3md.test -> 302 to /auth/consent?authorization_id=...; getAuthorizationDetails returns client/user/scope; JWKS ES256 asymmetric. bun test 86/86, tsc clean, oxlint 0/0.

human_review.reason: Hosted Supabase project settings (OAuth server + asymmetric JWT keys + consent URL) and Claude end-to-end connection on hosted are operator actions (no credentials in scope).

follow_ups.note: Hosted: Settings -> JWT keys asymmetric; Auth -> OAuth Server enabled, dynamic registration on, consent URL https://<site>/auth/consent; then Claude Desktop connect end to end on hosted (per docs/backend-architecture/local-workflow-and-deploy.md and auth-and-onboarding.md).
PSI-075 (Connected apps page with revoke) is now unblocked.
